name: Tuta Mail
author: Tutao GmbH
summary: Tutanota is an email client with a strong focus on security and privacy that lets you encrypt emails on all your devices.
description:
Tutanota is the worlds most secure email service, easy to use and private by design.
With end-to-end encryption and 2FA, your emails have never been more secure.
The built-in encryption guarantees that your mailbox belongs to you.
Nobody can decrypt or read your data.

versions.release_notes:
What's new
- Extend Inbox Rule Functionality (client able to handle Extended Inbox Rules) #11201
- Add OLED Dark Theme (Thanks @its-me-kyro) #11779
- Use ArchiveEnumerationService to get calculatedSize for MailDetailsBlob archives to be downloaded for indexing #11649
- Implement downloading encrypted MailDetails archives natively #11496
- Search for contacts using more fields #9170
- Make ConfigurationDatabase available offline #11570
- Add exceptions required for tranformation #11770

Bugfixes
- TutaSseFacade may attempt to fetch notifications while suspended on desktop #11723
- Folder does not display any mails when it contains one incoming mail with a null MailDetailsBlob #11703
- Mail indexing fails with single null mailDetailsBlob #11750
- Corrupted drafts stall mail indexing #11685
- Show more button is not showing when the search list is empty #11607
- Clearing Cache does not cancel indexing #11705
- Inconsistent behavior in Trash vs its subfolders #11571
- Checkbox is not checked when selecting multiple mails in the maillist. #11709
- Handle deleting range while extending it #11696
- Adjust the colours of the draft conflict dialogue to conform to the specification #11616
- Make mail-body a class, not id #11759

What's new
- Option to open attachments in mail editor
- Support for migrating via Google and Microsoft's API during Tuta's One-Click Migration - in addition to IMAP

Bugfixes
- Deactivating aliases when deactivating a shared mailbox
- Flashing and losing selection when lists reload
- Spam rules not being updated correctly
- Show error message when there are connection issues while migrating via Proton Mail Bridge
- Connection errors related to Tuta's One-Click Migration
- Connection errors related to SSE under unstable connections
- Connection issues after re-starting the device on desktop

What's new
- improved subscription settings and upgrade dialog
- permanent opt-out for feedback dialog
- link to alternative payment methods in upgrade dialog

Bugfixes
- allow new accounts to receive mail immediately after approval
